meta.note: Gated condition: Jev's Codebook-A gate (binary 'does reactance exist?') selects the comments; the type task (Codebook B) is then the CONDITIONAL six-class task 'which type, given reactance?'. Downstream `keine_reaktanz` answers are reported as gate rejections, not as a seventh type. This is a RETROSPECTIVE conditional reanalysis of the stored seven-class predictions; the intended production pipeline would prompt the second stage with only the six types after the gate passes.
